verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 10

No BC date given; Daniel (c. 84) stayed in Babylon after the first return; three weeks of partial fast (no pleasant food, meat, wine or anointing); the man in linen: some see a Christophany (cf. Rev 1:12–16), others a high-ranking angel — Guzik leans to an angel because Michael had to help; the prince of Persia is "a demon of high rank", not a human ruler; Michael Israel's guardian (Rev 12; Jude 9); cites Walvoord, Wood, Baldwin, Spurgeon, Archer
